name: Rumeen Farhana
role: Independent MP, lawyer, and former BNP leader
contribution: A barrister and former BNP lawmaker who contested Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent after being denied the party nomination and won the seat in the 2026 parliamentary election.
context: Rumeen Farhana previously served as a BNP member of parliament from a reserved women’s seat and held a party leadership role. In 2026, she ran with the Duck symbol after BNP’s alliance arrangement assigned the constituency to Jamiat candidate Junayed Al Habib; BNP later expelled her for contesting independently.
impact: Her victory made Brahmanbaria-2 a prominent example of independent electoral competition against a major-party alliance candidate. It also kept questions of party nomination, personal political identity, and constituency-level support visible in the 2026 election record.
highlight: Former BNP lawmaker who won Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent in 2026.
seoTitle: Rumeen Farhana: Independent MP from Brahmanbaria-2
seoDescription: Learn about barrister Rumeen Farhana, the former BNP lawmaker who won Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent candidate in Bangladesh’s 2026 parliamentary election.
shortAnswer: Rumeen Farhana is a Bangladeshi barrister and former BNP lawmaker who won Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent candidate in the 2026 election.

faq.question: Which constituency did Rumeen Farhana win in 2026?
faq.answer: She won Brahmanbaria-2 as an independent candidate in the 2026 parliamentary election.

faq.question: Why did Rumeen Farhana contest as an independent?
faq.answer: After she did not receive the BNP nomination for Brahmanbaria-2, she contested independently; reporting later described her expulsion from BNP for running against the party-aligned candidate.
